newsitem.title: USA: Reptile suits win pet/owner lookalike contest.
newsitem.headline: Reptile suits win pet/owner lookalike contest.

text.p: A man and his dog dressed as reptiles with matching gecko suits won this year's Key West pet/owner lookalike contest.
A couple who dressed themselves and their six dogs in dolphin costumes could only lick their wounds after Geckos in Paradise won the annual Pet Masquerade on Wednesday night.

About 75 pets competed in the event, one of the zaniest and most popular of the island's nine-day Halloween Fantasy Fest romp, in which men dress like women, women sometimes wear very little and even pets get into the fun.
Echo Grey and her Great Dane, Jagger, wearing outfits of painted zebra stripes and little else, took the prize for the most exotic costume, but nothing matched the grand finale.

In an ode to a Las Vegas nightclub act, Key Wester Frank Cicalese and his chihuahua, Sam, were rolled onto stage wearing maching, glittery green Statue of Liberty outfits. The duo -- backed by a bevy of show girls -- danced to a disco tune before an audience of about 1,000 spectators.
